what: External conditions that would change what this repository can study. Machine-readable trigger definitions only: there is no scheduler in this repository and nothing here polls anything.
howItIsUsed: a future session reads this file, checks the conditions by hand or by whatever means it lawfully has, and if one is met, follows the action written beside it. A trigger is not a prediction that the condition will occur.
separateFrom: adoption_registry.json records events that HAVE been verified. This file records conditions that have NOT occurred and what to do if they do.

triggers.condition: an official Board of Grievances judgment collection covering 1445 AH or later exists
triggers.checkBy: the Board's judicial-codices index, or a national-platform service listing, or an official announcement
action: re-run the access audit in bog_access_audit.json
if permitted, take an acquisition pilot and run the privacy gate before any bulk step
run the transport tests listed in the preregistration
activate bog_judicial_research_ai@preregistered
re-evaluate the event class on the E0-E5 ladder

triggers.condition: a verified, officially sourced AI deployment affecting legal research or reasoning in the Ministry of Justice COMMERCIAL courts
action: add the event to adoption_registry.json with its channel
this is the only condition that would raise an event to L3_WORKFLOW_MATCH in a corpus already held
freeze a pre-period immediately, before any post data arrives

triggers.condition: a verified institutional legal-research AI deployment affecting advocacy, from a bar association or named firms
action: record it; the advocacy channel is the one this corpus observes best and currently has no verified event

triggers.condition: ai_radar.py returns any judgment at LEVEL 3
action: record the judgment, its date, the court's own words, the concept family, the codes cited beside it, and the voice
one occurrence is an occurrence; three in a year or two under one code is a family and earns its own measurement

triggers.condition: a new Saudi instrument enters observed commercial adjudication, defined as first court citation in a SCORABLE quarter
action: start the new-law uptake monitor for it
compare its velocity against the Civil Transactions Law profile: 2 quarters from first court citation to the top 50

triggers.condition: an amendment to a provision inside the operational core, where the version metadata is verifiable
action: record the commencement date
note that article-version history is NOT held, so the amendment can only be aligned at instrument level

triggers.condition: authority.py or companions.py changes in a way that alters what counts as an authority
action: open a NEW MEASUREMENT ERA
do not stitch detector series across the boundary: a parser improvement raises named-source share exactly like better citation practice would

triggers.condition: a recurring legal formula (a wording fingerprint in ten or more judgments) is observed carrying a SECOND canonical non-statutory source, after source masking
triggers.checkBy: re-run formula_analysis.py and read phase4_sourceMasking.shellsWithMoreThanOneSource; the frozen baseline is 0
action: re-read PHASE 4: a source-independent judicial shell would be a different object from what is measured now
re-run the class ablation, because the removal criterion would then be removing shells as well as passages
record it as an observation of wording, never as evidence that any court took a formula from anywhere

triggers.condition: near-exact formula grouping holds across minhash Jaccard thresholds 0.6 to 0.8, at or above 0.6 pair survival
triggers.checkBy: phase3_exactVersusFamily.stability.shareSurvivingAt80 in formula_analysis_results.json; the frozen baseline is 0.5462
action: report every exact-formula count in the frozen baseline as a floor
re-run PHASES 4 to 9 at the family level and compare, without replacing the exact-level numbers

triggers.condition: the coupling archetypes contain any ONE_FORMULA_MANY_SOURCES unit
triggers.checkBy: phase8_sourceFormulaCoupling.archetypes; the frozen baseline is 0 against 215 MANY_FORMULAS_ONE_SOURCE
action: treat it as the coupling-level form of FORMULA_SHELL_RECEIVES_SECOND_SOURCE and follow that trigger

triggers.condition: a legislative instrument with a KNOWN legal clock -- an announcement date and an effective date independent of this corpus -- arrives in the window and reaches at least 200 court judgments
triggers.checkBy: legal_signal_registry.json against horizon_results.json's new-law monitor; two events qualify today
action: run transition.py; the third signature joins the library
re-read TRANSITION_BET_001: four transitions sharing an ordering would earn it, two do not
do NOT re-freeze frozen/three_layer_baseline.json; a third event opens a new era

triggers.condition: an adoption-registry event reaches L3_WORKFLOW_MATCH or above -- a verified deployment inside the adjudicatory workflow this corpus observes
triggers.checkBy: adoption_registry.json corpus_linkability, and transition_results.json phase34_observabilityMatrixV2, where every event already carries its expected first layer and its falsifier
action: register a PROSPECTIVE transition object BEFORE observable_from
freeze the six-quarter evaluation horizon at registration and never extend it
score CONSISTENT_WITH or INCONSISTENT_WITH the channel hypothesis; never AI_DETECTED_FROM_TEXT
if no expected layer moves inside the horizon, record NO_OBSERVABLE_SHIFT_WITHIN_HORIZON, which is a result

triggers.condition: laws.boe.gov.sa or the Umm Al-Qura gazette becomes fetchable from this environment, or a publication date for an in-window instrument turns up in a locally held official text
triggers.checkBy: re-run the two S3 publication dates in clocks.py against the official page; check legal_clock_registry.json for any instrument still at C1 or C2 whose rule is known
action: upgrade the affected clocks from C3 to C4 and re-run clocks.py
re-run the promotion gate; a C2 instrument that becomes C3 may qualify
do NOT re-freeze frozen/legal_clock_era_1.json; a better clock opens a new era

triggers.condition: a fourth instrument passes the promotion gate in clocks_results.json phase10_promotion
triggers.checkBy: clocks.py after any new quarter of corpus or any clock upgrade
action: run transition_era2.py; leave-one-transition-out becomes runnable at four
re-evaluate TRANSITION_BET_001 against the STRENGTHENED gate, which is not lowered
re-test whether any latency dimension is stable enough to make the AI comparator constructible
